reference: Fixed-nuclei neutral centrosymmetric molecule with closed-shell RHF/cc-pVDZ. Ground effective energy0; positive TDA excitation energy from the same calculation.
basis: Reference effective label g, one computed isolated dipole-bright TDA singlet label e. This is an approximate response-derived basis, not exported exact many-electron wavefunctions.
dipole: Length-gauge PySCF transition moment from int1e_r and spin-adapted X. Model root phase absorbs the electronic minus sign so projected physical dipole is positive. Diagonal moments vanish under explicitly required inversion/nondegenerate parity assumptions.
hamiltonian: H(t)=diag(0,gap_Eh)-E_au(t) sum_a polarization_a mu_a, hbar=1; real sin-squared-envelope cosine field, frequency=carrier_ratio*computed_gap, physical time in atomic units.
controls: Field strength, polarization, carrier ratio, phase and duration are externally specified experimental controls, NOT first-principles predictions. Electronic gap/dipole must come from actual PySCF, never synthetic defaults.
state: Complex128 two-component normalized ket. Populations=|c_g|^2,|c_e|^2; coherence=rho_ge=c_g c_e*. Scientific arrays persisted as byte-hashed NPZ. Effective electronic labels do not imply exact electronic occupations.

operation_semantics.APPLY_EXTERNAL_FIELD: Changes the effective Hamiltonian control only; no propagation
operation_semantics.PREPARE_ELECTRONIC_STATE: Sets a supported basis ket as an explicit boundary condition, not a simulated physical preparation mechanism
operation_semantics.EVOLVE_QUANTUM_STATE: QuTiP sesolve advances the existing ket and physical time under the selected control
operation_semantics.MEASURE_STATE_POPULATION: Reads existing probabilities, no measurement collapse/backaction simulation

truncation: Only two states. Weak amplitude screens against computed level scales are necessary screens, NOT complete error bounds. Omitted levels, multiphoton pathways, continuum, nuclei, decoherence and exact molecular spectra remain unverified.
numerical_QA: normalize_output=False. Norm/probability, explicit complex-array restore, zero-field analytic phase/constant-energy software check; single predeclared tighter ODE-tolerance replica. Driven-system energy is not required constant.
failure: Persist completed electronic/primary-propagation arrays, parent states and isolated-worker failure receipt. No implicit model fallback, relaxed thresholds, extra roots or retry.
